title: Match the domain score to PowerDMARC's output exactly. Decided 2026-07-26:
blocker: parity is the goal, so any divergence in the SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI/MTA-STS/TLS-RPT weights is a bug, not a design choice. Blocked on reference data this run cannot obtain: PowerDMARC's scores are behind their account, and scraping or signing up for a third-party service is not something to do unattended.
unblock: The user supplies a handful of domains with PowerDMARC's reported score for each (a spread of good/partial/broken configurations is worth more than many similar ones); then `computeDomainScore` can be diffed against them and the weights tuned, with the reference set pinned as a test. Note 2026-07-24: the DKIM key-length estimator fix changed reported bit values, so any reference capture must post-date it.
